## 2024-05-24 - QR Code XSS Vulnerability
**Vulnerability:** XSS vulnerability through `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` when rendering SVG QR codes generated by `qrcode-generator`.
**Learning:** `createSvgTag()` output was being directly injected into the DOM, which could lead to XSS if the QR payload contained malicious SVG content.
**Prevention:** Always use `createDataURL()` and render it safely using a standard `<img src={...} />` tag instead of injecting raw SVG markup.
